title: Intracranial current source density (CSD) during epileptic seizures and interictal periods, one patient (Budapest)
description: Derivative dataset of intracranial current source density (CSD) traces from a single patient with drug-resistant epilepsy, recorded at the National Institute for Clinical Neurosciences in Budapest. It contains 18 seizure segments and 16 interictal segments, each 20480 samples across four channels. The CSD was computed by the original authors from subdural ECoG at fronto-lateral, inferior-parietal and fronto-basal sites. The paper describes 1-30 Hz Butterworth filtering and rank normalization, but the deposited values are integers, so it is not stated whether the files are before or after these steps. CSD units are not stated by the source. The data were used to demonstrate causal inference between dynamical systems.
methods_description: A 20-year-old patient with drug-resistant epilepsy was implanted with an ADTECH subdural grid and strips (10 mm inter-contact spacing) for pre-surgical evaluation. Video-EEG was recorded with a Micromed Brain-Quick System Evolution at 1024 Hz. CSD was computed at four sites (Fl1, Fl2, iP, Fb) and the traces were converted to BrainVision float32 format.
